name: What should I consider before designing an outdoor kitchen with a gas line?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before designing an outdoor kitchen with a gas line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before designing an outdoor kitchen with a gas line, consider the desired appliances, their BTU requirements, and the proximity to your home's existing gas supply. Planning ahead for utility access can significantly impact the overall project cost and complexity. Our initial consultation process helps you outline these factors early on, allowing us to integrate gas line placement seamlessly into the overall outdoor kitchen design, rather than as an afterthought.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider desired appliances, BTU needs, and proximity to your gas supply to integrate the gas line seamlessly into the design.
